title: Nanopore Library Preparation for Scapharca Broughtonii
author: Chang-Ming CM Bai
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.z8bf9sn
materials: Ligation Loading Bead Kit R9 Version
DNA fragments were end-repaired using NEBNext FFPE Repair Mix (NEB, M6630). The precedures was keeped at 20℃, 15 min.
DNA fragments were end-repaired and dA-tailed by using the NEBNext End repair / dA-tailing Module (NEB, E7546). The precedures was keeped at 20℃, 30 min, and then at 60℃, 30 min.

Nanopore adaptors were ligated to the dA-tailed DNA fragment by using Ligation Sequencing Kit 1D R9 Version (Nanopore, SQK-LSK108) and NEB Blunt/TA Ligase Master Mix (NEB, M0367). The precedures was keeped at 20℃, 60 min.
The concerntration of the library was detected with Qubit 3.0 (Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc., Carlsbad, CA, USA), and proved to be qualified for sequencing.

steps.title: Fragment Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Fragment approximately 6 μg of genomic DNA using a Megaruptor (Diagenode, Seraing, Belgium) to obtain ~20kb fragments.

substeps.instruction: Verify fragment sizes using an Agilent Bioanalyzer 2100 system (Agilent Technologies, Palo Alto, CA, USA), ensuring main fragments are >17 Kb.

steps.title: Select and Purify Fragments
steps.instruction: Select fragments with size > 15 Kb and purify the resulting DNA.

substeps.instruction: Select fragments > 15 Kb using the BluePippin Size-Selection system (Sage Science, Beverly, the U.S.).
Purify the selected fragments using AMPure XP beads (Agencourt, Beverly, the U.S.).

steps.title: Purify Repaired Fragments
steps.instruction: Purify the repaired fragments using AMPure XP beads (Agencourt, Beverly, the U.S.).

steps.title: Perform Nanopore Library Ligation
steps.instruction: Carry out the ligation process using the Ligation Loading Bead Kit R9 Version (EXP-LLB001) and MinION Flow Cell (FLO-MIN106) according to the user manual.
